Details: PrepareModularFormOutput[<|name -> y, ...|>] snapshots named modular forms for export: every output is a vector (shape {d}, also d = 1) with its form ID and revision, weight, irrep, basis, assignment and group identities.

A form under several names shares one frozen node; the output carries every frozen record (definition, coefficients, anchor frame, stored expansion, evidence) and a content digest. Nothing is computed; Missing data stay Missing and ToPython decides what can be exported.
PrepareModularFormOutput.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; PrepareModularFormOutput[<|"Y" -> y, "Same" -> y|>]["Outputs"][[All, "Shape"]]]

Details: ModularFormOutput[data] is the immutable export snapshot of named modular forms made by PrepareModularFormOutput; out["Outputs"], out["Nodes"] and out["Digest"] read it.
Later coefficient solves, expansions or group changes never alter it; ToPython validates it (forged records or digests fail) before generating a module.
ModularFormOutput.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; Head[PrepareModularFormOutput[<|"Y" -> y|>]]]

Details: Option of ModularFormView and ModularFormTable: custom labels by form ID (strings or TeXFragment) replacing the automatic label Y^(k)_r.
Default <||>; labels change appearance only, and a form ID that is not displayed fails InvalidOption.
Option of FormSlotTable and the model views (ModelView, FieldTable, ContractionTable, CouplingTable, MassMatrixView, ModelOutputView): custom labels by form-slot ID.
Default <||>; slot labels otherwise come from the slot records (Y^(k)_r with a Roman copy index when the space has more than one copy); unknown slot IDs fail InvalidOption.
Option of ModularFormView and ModularFormTable: "Normalized" substitutes the stored resolved coefficients, "Raw" shows the normalization parameters.
Default "Normalized"; unresolved coefficients show the raw expression with the status Unresolved and assign no value.
Option of the modular views: the number of known nonzero q-series terms shown per component.
Default 6, or All; hidden known terms are marked and the stored cutoff O(q^n) is always shown; the stored data are not changed.
Option of the modular views: True writes a series as c q^r (1 + ...) when its first known coefficient is established nonzero.
Default True; the remainder is written inside as O(q^(n - r)) so the cutoff keeps its meaning; unresolved or ambiguous leading terms are not factored.
Option of ModularFormTable: True shows a column of the actual weight k of every form.
Default True; with False the weight stays in the document data.
Option of ToPython for modular outputs: "Embedded" evaluates the frozen bound forms inside the module, "External" (model outputs only) takes caller-supplied form_values keyed by slot ID.
Default "Embedded" (needs every used slot bound with resolved coefficients); External reports UnknownExternalError and is incompatible with RequireProof.

Option of ToPython for modular outputs: Automatic ("QSeries": adaptive q-series of the frozen recipes), "FiniteSeries" (a stored expansion or finite jet at an explicit SeriesOrder) or "Analytic" (unavailable, as in Stage 7).
Default Automatic; FiniteSeries reports a finite approximation without a tail bound and refuses accuracy goals.
